content: STAGE 1 start: goal = read manifest + in-scope files (train_rqvae.py, model/model.py, tests/test_ddp.py) for BRad-RQ r5. Nothing read yet. Next: read manifest.

STAGE 2 result (final). Read manifest, train_rqvae.py (639 lines), model/model.py, model/layers.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/__init__.py, tests/test_ddp.py. Findings: (1) trained arm has frechet_codebook=False so VQLayer.frechet is None: no manual .data codebook write runs at all; the codebook moves only through optimizer.step on DDP-reduced grads; every requires_grad param (encoder MLP, decoder MLP, 3x embed.weight) is inside the loss (quant_loss term mse(x_q,x.detach()) reaches embed.weight, recon reaches decoder, ST reaches encoder) so find_unused_parameters=False is safe on step 2+. Collectives: layers.py:211 broadcast(centers) + train_rqvae.py:429 broadcast(code_embs) + :430 barrier once before the loop; layers.py:165 all_reduce(used) 3x per training step (one per RQ level) symmetric; DDP grad bucket all_reduce inside loss.backward() (train_rqvae.py:478); train_rqvae.py:503-504 all_reduce(loss,recon) once per epoch; barriers 551/600. Eval/export rank-0-only forward guarded by layer._skip_ddp_reduce (layers.py:163-165,184) so no asymmetric collective; dead frechet block 485-493 emits nothing because sums==[] on every rank. Shared state: radii computed identically on every rank from the train parquet (deterministic float64 math + tie-by-id sort), set via set_radii as NON-persistent buffer after DDP wrap with broadcast_buffers=False, so never broadcast but equal by determinism; codebook equal because KMeans is broadcast at layers.py:211 and train_rqvae.py:429 and afterwards only DDP-reduced optimizer steps move it. Minor findings: test_ddp.py's config uses frechet_codebook=True and has no 'radial' attribute, so it tests the arm the trainer disables and never exercises the radial all_reduce or a live codebook param under the reducer; total_steps uses per-rank len(loader) so single-card LR schedule is 4x longer (18000 vs 72000 steps). Verdict for both of my checks: PASS with minor findings.
